title: Chapter 726
text:
The battlefield of the secret war was too vast. A small battle on this front did not receive much attention, and only Joad was so concerned about it.

Regardless of Bloodshed Land's reaction, after the battle was won, Han Xiao rejected Rexson's invitation to celebrate and took Hella to the other blockade line bases, providing her with more battlefields to pick up Gray Souls.

Just as Han Xiao and the others were moving around the various battlefields, a new hot topic appeared on the forums. Many players who had attacked Stronghold W-58 uploaded videos, and Hella's reappearance reminded the players of long ago memories.

Originally, this was just a very ordinary battle video. However, when they thought about how Han Xiao and Hila were still together even after going through three versions, especially when they found out about the 'old relationship' between Han Xiao and Hila in Galaxy Chronicles Version 1.0, the topic inevitably turned to gossip. The various editors of the shocking news department all showed their prowess.

"Shocking! Black Star actually did such a thing to Hella! " "Old Love Rekindled? Or Looking for a New Love? " "A Love That Spanned Twenty Years. Boys Will Be Silent, Girls Will Cry!" "Who Is Black Star's Favorite Woman? Counting the Beauties He Loved Over the Years … "

The players were the most interested in gossip. After all, they did not have to take responsibility in the future, so they started to fill in the gaps. The topic gradually turned from Hella to Black Star, trying to dig deeper into his feelings.

Han Xiao was now the most famous NPC in the hearts of the players in the Shattered Star Ring. He had a high status, a strong family background, and was quite handsome. Since Version 1.0, the players had never been clear about his love story. They were extremely curious about the love story of the faction leader. Just by filling in the blanks, they could come up with more than a dozen CEO romances.

Not only Hella, but all the known living female characters related to the Black Star Corps, such as Ames, Sylvia, Aroshia, and so on, became the object of intense debate among the players. On the forums, the supporters of the different female characters split into several factions and argued with each other.

"Hella has known each other the longest. It's obvious that they've rekindled their feelings for each other."

"Bah, the young plum is no match for the heavens. The Dragon Emperor Faction will never be a slave!"

"What do you know? Sylvia is the king. This is the Nurturing Element!"

"The Herlous party laughed but said nothing."

"The Harmon Faction refuses to accept this and will chop off your heads."

"Come on, you guys are very weak. Greetings from the Philip Gang."

"The Fu Ding Gang has announced their withdrawal. Fu Ding is our husband. Black Star, you're not worthy of her!"

"The Gold Daiko gang hugged the little salted fish tightly and didn't dare to speak."

"At this time, Aroshia is still on the way."

"The Germinal Organization leader is watching you silently from heaven. It's not that I'm targeting anyone, but everyone here is like a younger brother to me."

The hot topic on the forums increased the popularity of the many officers of the Black Star Corps. As the main character of the topic, Black Star received a wave of praise.

The gossip of big shots was always popular, and Han Xiao did not pay much attention to it. Such gossip topics would appear on the forums from time to time for the players to entertain themselves. Regardless of whether there was a conclusion or not, it would not have any effect. The only substantial effect it would cause would be to indirectly increase the production of dungeons …

…

After passing through a few blockade lines, Hella picked up Gray Souls, and her combat strength increased rapidly. In just half a month, her Energy Rank increased by more than 400 Ona. At her level, this growth speed was enough to shock ninety-nine percent of Supers of the same level.

During this time, Han Xiao made a few moves. The Spirit Barrier and the enchantment on his body reduced the growth speed of the Soul Embryo by about half. The growth rate of the Soul Embryo increased from four percent to nine percent.

However, quite a number of army players had already reached Grade B, and these people began to use their experience to learn Class Knowledge. In this half a month, Han Xiao finally gathered enough experience to reach level 220.

Han Xiao stopped his journey, patted Fu Ding, and eagerly locked himself in the training room.

Opening the interface, Han Xiao stared at the huge amount of experience and smiled in satisfaction.

After seven years, he could finally advance. It was not easy.

Without hesitation, he invested all his experience into leveling up.

[Apostle Mechanic] leveled up to LV25. + 240 Energy, + 3 STR, + 4 DEX, + 5 END, + 10 INT. You have received 8 Free Attribute Points and 1 Potential Point.

After leveling up twice in a row, he was now level 220, once again stepping on the threshold of his Promotion.

The requirements for the Promotion Mission popped up on the interface. This time, Han Xiao did not even look at it.

The Mission Completion Card that he had accumulated for seven years was finally put to use!

Promotion directly!

Use [Mission Completion Card]? Confirm/Give?

"Use."

Target selected Promotion Mission.

You have used [Mission Completion Card].

[Brink of Death] calculating … calculation complete!

LV220 Promotion Mission completed! Promotion successful! END bonus increased! 1 END = 175 HP = 185 Stamina

This time, his END bonus increased by 30 points, which was 5 points higher.

A hot stream gushed out of his heart and spread throughout his body in an instant. Every cell in his body was excited, and Han Xiao could feel the increase in his vitality.

Han Xiao focused. This Promotion was still the Race Evolution that would occur once every 40 levels. He focused 120% and looked at the notifications on the interface.

He had just taken advantage of Fu Ding's luck, so he hoped that he could draw some good options …

You have taken another step forward on the path of evolution. Your life level has been upgraded, and your genetic code has been reorganized. You are closer to a new starting point in life …

Race detected: [Void Distorter (Human Form)] … Randomly drawing nine matching evolution paths … Drawing complete!

Please choose one of the nine options below as your evolved race. Warning! The evolution process is irreversible. Please choose carefully. [Appendix: Evolution Path Characteristics Description]

[Void Rainbow (Energy Field Form)] -38% Compatibility

[Void Jumper (Mutant Form)] -44% Compatibility

[Void Magus (Spirit Form)] -28% Compatibility

[Multi-Dimensional Shadow (Mental Signal Form)] -23% Compatibility

[Void Executioner (Human Form)] -71% Compatibility

[Blade of Magomondo (Human Form)] -57% Compatibility

[Void Star Pursuer (Human Form)] -75% Compatibility

[Void Dragon Highly Concentrated Hybrid (Human Form)] -66% Compatibility.

[Saint Universe Human Race (Gene Limiter Removed)] -54% Compatibility

Staring at the nine options in front of him, Han Xiao had a headache.

It was not that these options were bad, but they were too good!

It was difficult for him to choose.

Because he had once consumed the Void Lord's core, Han Xiao had directly skipped an evolution stage. If not for that core, the options that appeared now would have been a species of the same level as the Void Distorter.

But now, there were several options that were higher than the Void Distorter's evolution direction.

Han Xiao first eliminated the first four options. These four gave up on the human form, and the compatibility was too low. They were not compatible with his ability. He was troubled by the last five options.

[Void Star Pursuer] was the direct evolution direction of the current race, the Void Distorter. It was a cosmic life form that fed on cosmic radiation and the energy of the stars. [Void Executioner] was good at fighting, and it was in the upper-middle chain of the void life form system. It was equivalent to a high-level warlord that led a small army.

'Mago Modor' was a Void Lord recorded in history. It used Void Energy to transform powerful Void Warriors, creating a special elite troop type, which was the [Blades of Mago Modor]. It was very powerful, and if one had to describe it, it was like a fierce general who could fight one against a hundred, qualified to fight one on one in front of a formation.

[High Density Void Dragon Hybrid] should be the evolution direction brought about by the Void Dragon Marrow that he had consumed before. Han Xiao was not too sure about the final result of this evolution direction. Would the overbearing Void Dragon genes eventually rewrite his own genes and turn him into a Void Dragon or some other strange aberration?

The final [Holy Cosmic Human] was one of the endpoints of the evolution chain of the Cosmic Human Race. Removing the gene limiter was very tempting, as it would make up for a huge amount of attributes.

However, compared to the Void system, which still had the potential to evolve, Han Xiao did not really want to choose this. Most evolutionary systems would have the effect of removing the gene limiter at the end, and the Void system was no exception.

"Which one should I choose …" Han Xiao was in a dilemma and paced back and forth.

He was getting closer and closer to Beyond Grade A. This might be the last chance for a Race Evolution before he reached Beyond Grade A, so he was very cautious.

"If I consider the increase in combat strength, the Holy Cosmic Human Race is the best, followed by the Magomondo Blades. In terms of potential, the Star Chaser is the strongest, and the Executioner is the best. As for the Void Dragon Hybrid, the subsequent evolution of this chain is probably not suitable for me …"

After pondering for a while, Han Xiao finally chose to focus on potential, hesitating between the Star Chaser and the Executioner.

The Executioner's evolution direction was toward the Void Duke and Void Lord, while the Star Chaser's evolution direction was toward the Void New Ancestor and Void Oracle's evolution direction.

"Race Talents have very little effect on my combat strength. It's better to choose the more long-term potential …"

Han Xiao took a deep breath and made his decision.

Selection complete. Race Evolution … Evolution complete!

Race changed to [Void Star Chaser (Human Form)]. Molecular structure improved, organ structure strengthened, metabolism changed, adaptability increased, genetic coding optimized … Your potential has increased!

You have received attributes: + 154 STR, + 179 DEX, + 323 END, + 188 INT, + 120 MYS, + 70 CHA, + 3,760 Energy. Energy Level bonus attribute changed!

Han Xiao's senses exploded!

It was like his soul had left his body, and his mind was clear, rising slowly, while his body was turbid, falling steadily. His body and soul seemed to be separated, but in reality, they were closely connected.

His senses seemed to extend endlessly, and the range kept expanding, exceeding this Star System, this Star Cluster, and this Star Field. It was as if he could see the entire universe in a single glance.

Although this was just an illusion, it was so real that he experienced a super high dimensional perspective for an instant.

The next moment, a strong pulling force exploded, and Han Xiao's senses returned to his body.

His body structure was rapidly transforming, and the pain was unbearable. However, during the transformation process, Han Xiao's senses became sharper and sharper, and he even gained a few more sensory fields, which gave him a few more ways to view the world.

Although everything in front of him did not change, in his senses, it was already completely different.

"Hu …"

Finally, the pain subsided, and Han Xiao let out a long breath. Extremely small energy crystals were wrapped in his breath, flashing with grayish-blue light.

As soon as the Species Transformation was completed, Han Xiao took out a mirror and confirmed that nothing strange had grown on his body.

His hair … wasn't bald. It was still very thick.

His appearance … was still as handsome as ever.

Her figure … Hmm, nice.

Tail … Fortunately, it hadn't grown out yet.

Han Xiao nodded in satisfaction. Although he was no longer a human, he still wanted to look like a human due to aesthetic reasons.

After examining it from head to toe three times, Han Xiao opened the interface and invested the remaining EXP into leveling up.

After the advancement, the experience required to level up once again skyrocketed, but he only managed to level up by one level.

As cosmic lifeforms, Star Chasers had extremely strong physiques. Hence, the Race Evolution had increased their attributes a lot.

He opened his personal attributes and checked his changes.

Level: 221

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Void Star Pursuer (Human Form)

Stats: 810 STR, 1316 DEX, 1658 END, 3455 INT, 654 MYS, 284 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 24

Potential Points: 15

HP: 456060

Stamina: 382120

Energy: 35530 [Lv.13]

Lv.13 Energy Bonus Points: + 279 STR, + 374 DEX, + 466 END, + 544 INT, + 308 MYS, + 50520 Stamina, + 467% Machinery Affinity (Super Electromagnetic Induction)

Energy Rank: 29277

Grade: A +

Grade A Bonuses: + 15 END, + 12 All Resistances, + 15% Highest Attribute, + 8% Other Attributes, + 80 Free Attribute Points, + 10 Potential Points.

[Hello, tank. Goodbye, tank.]

The amount of HP he had was enough to make him want to vomit.

Other than the fact that he had completed the Race Evolution, his energy had also broken through the 30,000 mark. He had obtained the bonus from the thirteenth level, which provided him with a few hundred attribute points.

The effect of this Promotion was very impressive, and the gap between him and the Beyond Grade A realm was further reduced.

Han Xiao hadn't enjoyed the thrill of a sudden increase in strength for seven years. At this moment, he only had one thought:

Shuang 'er, you're dead.

He entered his mind and took a look at the situation of the soul embryo. The growth rate of nine percent had been suppressed to less than one percent!

"Steady, really steady." Han Xiao chuckled.

You still want to be born? Wait for your miscarriage!
